decisions.reason: The FAQ already stated before message 210 that Transak directly mints the NFT to a newly created wallet address, so the source change does not alter its state.
Automatic creation of the fiat buyer's non-custodial wallet during the Transak purchase was already established by message 184.
The About-page content does not specify the destination wallet for Transak mint fulfillment, and the source change does not require that page to change.
The Mission-page requirement concerns project messaging and prize descriptions, not Transak purchase fulfillment or wallet provisioning.
Minting the purchased NFT to a newly created buyer wallet does not change ticket issuance, eligibility, expiration, or reset rules.
The destination of Transak mint fulfillment does not change the already established confirmation-email contents or notification behavior.
The prize collection requirement already sends prizes to the winner wallet; specifying that Transak mints a purchase to a newly created buyer wallet does not modify that collection flow.
The hero requirement changes presentation copy and layout, while the Transak fulfillment destination does not necessitate a hero-state change.
Transak mint fulfillment has no effect on the book cover's landing-page location or hero integration.
The buyer wallet receiving a fiat-purchased NFT does not alter winner selection, ticket weighting, eligibility, or Chainlink VRF behavior.
The Transak fulfillment destination does not change the PDF.js reader mode, technology, or entry points.
Minting the NFT to a newly created wallet does not affect the live display of sales remaining until the next prize draw.
